parsed.answer: Customers API 404 responses use the error code CUS-404 with the message "The customer does not exist." Payments API 404 responses use the error code PAY-404 with the message "The payment does not exist." Both return the same Problem object structure (type, title, status, code, detail, optional correlationId) with application/problem+json content.
